name: Mobile Phone Shop Simulator
detailed_description:
📱 Mobile Phone Shop Simulator is a detailed and immersive tycoon experience that lets you step into the shoes of a mobile phone shop owner!

🛠️ Start from scratch and build your very own mobile empire—buy and sell smartphones, offer repair services, and manage accessories.

💼 Expand your business, customize your shop, hire employees, and keep up with the latest phone trends to stay ahead of the competition.

👥 Attract diverse customers with unique needs and preferences—some want budget-friendly deals, others crave premium devices.

💡 Strategically stock your inventory and tackle unexpected challenges to grow your reputation.

🚀 Will you become the top shop in town or fade into the background?

✨ Every choice you make shapes your store’s destiny.

🎯 Ready to build your empire and become the go-to phone shop owner?

👉 Wishlist now and get ready to hustle!

🚀 What's Coming Next?

The demo for Mobile Phone Shop Simulator is just around the corner! You'll soon be able to experience the core gameplay loop — managing a phone shop, serving customers, and running your business.

But that's only the beginning.

🔓 Early Access Roadmap

After the demo, the Early Access version will launch with extended gameplay features, offering more depth and progression. You'll be able to:

  • 🏠 Live in your own house – a customizable space for your character.

  • 🛍️ Interact with sellers – manage a dedicated area for sellers to expand your shop.

  • 📦 Buy and sell stock – handle an evolving inventory with dynamic pricing.

🛠️ Full Release Goals

The Full Release will include all planned features and polish the entire experience based on community feedback. Here’s what’s coming in the full version:

  • 🔧 A complete repair system – fix broken phones and electronics to resell for profit.

  • 💬 Customers bringing devices – negotiate prices and decide what to buy.

  • 💼 Hire staff – recruit employees to automate or assist in daily tasks.

  • 🏪 Store expansions – unlock new sections, customize layouts, and grow your shop.

  • 🔨 Auction system – compete in live phone auctions to score rare devices.

  • 📺 New electronic items – expand your catalog with smartwatches, tablets, and accessories.

We are building Mobile Phone Shop Simulator with long-term vision and strong community support. Your feedback during Early Access will help shape the final version of the game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3550
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
